title: 敷島製パン「超熟」「スナックパン」など値上げ　7月から3～9％「価格維持難しい」
extracted_text: 敷島製パン（名古屋市）は1日、食パン「超熟　6枚スライス」や菓子パン「スナックパン　8本入」など約240品目を約3～9％値上げすると発表した。対象は7月1日納品分から。原材料価格の上昇や物流費の高騰などが理由。
translated_text: Shikishima Seipan (Nagoya) announced on the 1st that it will raise prices on about 240 items, including bread loaves such as 'Choju 6-slice' and confectionery breads like 'Snack Pan 8-pack,' by approximately 3-9%. The changes will apply to deliveries from July 1st, citing rising raw material prices and soaring logistics costs as the reasons.
title_en: Shikishima Seipan to Raise Prices on 'Choju' and 'Snack Pan' by 3-9% from July
